fact: NIRA says it launched three systems (HUBIYE, e-Aqoonsi, CDS) entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA, with World Bank Scaled-UP Project support.
NIRA's HUBIYE system was entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA, with World Bank project funding.
NIRA's e-Aqoonsi system was entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA, with World Bank project funding.
NIRA's CDS system was entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA, with World Bank project funding.

NIRA's Director General said the authority focused its in-house expertise on software development, policy oversight and coordination, and rolled out homegrown platforms Hubiye, e-Aqoonsi and the Certificate Delivery System.
system: Hubiye, e-Aqoonsi and Certificate Delivery System (CDS)
